heading: Reference to chapter 1803
lead: Provisions of law relating to facilities for reserve components are set forth in chapter 1803 of this title (beginning with section 18231).

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Prior sections 2231 to 2239 were renumbered sections 18231 to 18239 of this title, respectively.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Dec. 1, 1994, except as otherwise provided, see section 1691 of Pub. L. 103–337, set out as a note under section 10001 of this title.
